lesson: A rejected proposal is correctable, so read its reason rather than asking what went wrong. MODEL_PROPOSAL_INVALID carries a reasonCode and a reason naming the rule that broke. INVALID_REFERENCE is raised by several distinct rules, so only the reason distinguishes a missing dependsOn from a malformed JSON pointer. A schema rejection names the failing location as an RFC 6901 path and the rule, for example /values/1 expected type string but found number, or /values needs at least 1 item but has 0. References require a direct declared dependency in dependsOn. Correct the specific field the reason names and propose again.
